Android deletes it if you uninstall the app
To store the data in the SurvivalOS folder (so it is not lost if you uninstall the app), turn on «Allow access to all files» for Survival OS on the next screen and go back.
Without that permission this folder cannot be used. Choose another one (the app folder needs no permission, but Android deletes it on uninstall).
Survival OS uses the tablet\'s GNSS receiver to show your position on the map and record tracks, without Internet. Your location never leaves the device.
Keep working with the screen off

So that downloads, radio and GPS do not stop with the screen off, let Survival OS run without battery restrictions. On some brands (Realme, Xiaomi, Huawei…) also check «Auto-launch» and «Background activity» in the app settings.
Allow Survival OS to install apps so it can update itself, then try again.
